patthana3.4:1.1: āsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:2.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, kamme ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ, sahajātavāropi
patthana3.4:4.1: āsavaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:5.1: hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, avigate nava,
patthana3.4:6.1: na hetuyā ekaṃ, na adhipatiyā nava, …pe… na kamme tīṇi, na vipāke nava, na vippayutte nava,
patthana3.4:8.1: āsavo akusalo dhammo āsavassa akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana3.4:9.1: hetuyā satta, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, majjhe tiṇṇaṃ sahajātādhipati labbhati. anantare nava, …pe… upanissaye nava, āsevane nava, kamme tīṇi, …pe… magge nava,
patthana3.4:10.1: no āsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:11.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.4:14.1: sāsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:15.1: anāsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anāsavo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:16.1: hetuyā dve, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā dve, avigate dve,
patthana3.4:17.1: na adhipatiyā dve, na vippayutte dve, sahajātavārepi sampayuttavārepi sabbattha dve,
patthana3.4:18.1: sāsavo kusalo dhammo sāsavassa kusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana3.4:19.1: anāsavo kusalo dhammo anāsavassa kusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.4:20.1: hetuyā dve, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā tīṇi, upanissaye cattāri, avigate dve,
patthana3.4:21.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)
patthana3.4:22.1: sāsavaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:23.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.4:25.1: sāsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana3.4:26.1: anāsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anāsavo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, anāsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo abyākato ca anāsavo abyākato ca dhammo uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:27.1: sāsavaṃ abyākataṃ ca anāsavaṃ abyākataṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:28.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā pañca, vipāka pañca, avigate pañca,
patthana3.4:29.1: na hetuyā ekaṃ, na ārammaṇe tīṇi, na adhipatiyā dve,
patthana3.4:31.1: sāsavo abyākato dhammo āsavassa abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana3.4:32.1: anāsavo abyākato dhammo anāsavassa abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.4:33.1: hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe tīṇi, avigate satta. (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.) āsavavippayuttaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ, sahajātavārepi pañhāvārepi sabbattha ekaṃ. kusala dukacchedo.? akusala dukaṃ pana kiṃ.? āsavasampayuttaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavasampayutto akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. āsavavippayuttaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavasampayutto akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe pañca, avigate pañca, sahajātavārepi sampayuttavārepi sabbattha pañca. na hetuyā ekaṃ, na adhipatiyā pañca, na purejāte pañca, …pe… na kamme tīṇi, na vipāke pañca, na vippayutte pañca, …pe… āsava sampayutto akusalo dhammo āsavasampayuttassa akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo, tīṇi. āsava vippayutto akusalo dhammo āsavasampayuttassa akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe nava, avigate pañca,
patthana3.4:34.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)
patthana3.4:36.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:37.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ, na
patthana3.4:53.1: āsavavippayutto abyākato dhammo āsava vippayuttassa abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.4:54.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ
patthana3.4:55.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniyaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)
patthana3.4:57.1: sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:58.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.4:60.1: āsavañce va sāsavañca akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca
patthana3.4:67.1: āsavo ceva sāsavoca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā, tīṇi. sāsavañce va no ca āsavaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo ce va no ca āsavo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā, tīṇi. āsavañceva sāsavaṃ akusalañca sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ akusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva sāsavo ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, avigate nava, sāsavañce va no ca āsavaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva sāsavo ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati na hetupaccayā, na hetuyā ekaṃ, na adhipatiyā nava, na purejāte nava, na pacchājāte nava, na āsevane nava, na kamme tīṇi, na vipāke nava, na vippayutte nava, (sahajātavāropi paccayavāropi nissayavāropi saṃsaṭṭhavāropi sampayuttavāropi vitthāretabbo.) āsavo ceva sāsavo ca akusalo dhammo āsavassa ceva sāsavassa ca akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana3.4:68.1: hetuyā satta, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, avigate nava,
patthana3.4:69.1: āsavo ceva sāsavo ca akusalo dhammo āsavassaceva sāsavassa ca akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. sahajāta, upanissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana3.4:70.1: na hetuyā nava, na ārammaṇe nava,
patthana3.4:73.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)
patthana3.4:74.1: sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva no ca āsavo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:75.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.4:78.1: āsavañce va āsava sampayuttañca akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva āsava sampayutto ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.4:79.1: āsava sampayuttañca ca no ca āsavaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsava sampayuttoceva no ca āsavo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.4:80.1: āsavañceva āsava sampayuttaṃ akusalañca āsavasampayuttañce va no ca āsavaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.4:81.1: hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, avigate nava,
patthana3.4:82.1: āsavañce va āsava sampayuttañca akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati na adhipatipaccayā,
patthana3.4:83.1: na adhipatiyā nava, na purejāte nava, na pacchājāta nava, na āsevane nava, na kamme tīṇi, na vipāke nava, na vippayutte nava,
patthana3.4:85.1: āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca akusalo dhammo āsavassa ceva āsavasampayuttassa ca akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana3.4:86.1: hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, avigate nava,
patthana3.4:87.1: na hetuyā nava, na ārammaṇe nava,
patthana3.4:90.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)
patthana3.4:92.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto anāsavo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:93.1: hetuyā dve, ārammaṇe dve, avigate dve,
patthana3.4:95.1: āsava vippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:96.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto anāsavo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo abyākato ca āsavavippayutto anāsavo abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetu paccayā.
patthana3.4:97.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ abyākatañca āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.4:98.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā pañca, kamme pañca, vipāke pañcaṃ avigate pañca,
patthana3.4:99.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo abyākato dhammo uppajjati na hetu paccayā,
patthana3.4:100.1: na hetuyā ekaṃ, na ārammaṇe tīṇi, na adhipatiyā dve, no vigate tīṇi,
patthana3.4:101.1: (sahajātavāropi saccayavāropi nissayavāropi saṃsaṭṭhavāropi sampayuttavāropi paṭiccavārasadisaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)
patthana3.4:102.1: āsavavippayutto sāsavo abyākato dhammo āsavavippayuttassa sāsavassa abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo
patthana3.4:103.1: āsava vippayutto anāsavo abyākato dhammo āsavavippayuttassa anāsavassa abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo, āsavavippayutto anāsavo abyākato dhammo āsavavippayuttassa sāsavassa abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo, āsavavippayutto anāsavo abyākato dhammo āsavavippayuttassa sāsavassa abyākatassa ca āsava vippayuttassa anāsavassa abyākatassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.4:104.1: āsavavippayutto sāsavo abyākato dhammo āsavavippayuttassa sāsavassa abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.4:105.1: āsavavippayutto anāsavo abyākato dhammo āsavavippayuttassa anāsavassa abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo,
patthana3.4:106.1: hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā cattāri, anantare cattāri, samanantare cattāri, sahajāte pañca, aññamaññe dve, nissaye satta, upanissaye cattāri, purejāte dve, āsevane ekaṃ, kamme cattāri, vipāke cattāri, āhāre cattāri, avigate satta.
patthana3.4:107.1: āsavavippayutto sāsavo abyākato dhammo āsavavippayuttassa sāsavassa abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. sahajātapaccayena paccayo, upanissayapaccayena paccayo, purejātapaccayena paccayo, pacchājātapaccayena paccayo, āhārapaccayena paccayo, indriyapaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.4:108.1: na hetuyā satta, na ārammaṇe satta,
patthana3.4:111.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)
